findings.statement: The pretraining scripts take eccDNA coordinates from eccDNA Atlas (human, chicken, mouse) and CircleBase (human) and extract the sequences from the hg19, hg38, galGal4 and mm10 reference genomes.
findings.source_says: download_datasets.py downloads hg19, hg38, galGal4 and mm10, but extract_sequences.py opens only Fasta('data/genomes/hg19.fa'), Fasta('data/genomes/galGal4.fa') and Fasta('data/genomes/mm10.fa').
findings.fix: The pretraining scripts take eccDNA coordinates from eccDNA Atlas (human, chicken, mouse) and CircleBase (human) and extract the sequences from the hg19, galGal4 and mm10 reference genomes; the download script also fetches hg38.

findings.statement: Pretrained and task-specific fine-tuned weights, plus the task datasets, are openly available under Apache-2.0.
findings.source_says: hf-org-models.json tags all eight models "license:apache-2.0"; README: "All datasets and model weights are available on Hugging Face". No saved file gives the datasets' licence.
findings.fix: Pretrained and task-specific fine-tuned weights, plus the task datasets, are on Hugging Face; all eight model repositories are tagged Apache-2.0. The licence of the datasets is not stated in the sources read.

findings.statement: Code: https://github.com/zzq1zh/eccDNAMamba (the arXiv abstract links https://github.com/zzq1zh/GenAI-Lab). Weights and datasets: https://huggingface.co/eccDNAMamba, not gated.
findings.source_says: "gated":false appears only in hf-api.json (eccDNAMamba-1M); hf-org-models.json has no gated field, and hf-api-ultra-long.json was not cited for it.
findings.fix: Code: https://github.com/zzq1zh/eccDNAMamba (the arXiv abstract links https://github.com/zzq1zh/GenAI-Lab). Weights and datasets: https://huggingface.co/eccDNAMamba; eccDNAMamba-1M is not gated.

summary: Mostly reliable. Architecture, parameter counts, licence tags, the config inconsistency and the run steps match the saved files; the genome list includes hg38, which the extraction script does not use, and the datasets' licence and organisation-wide gating are not shown.
